analysis_title: Water-year differential snow-DA budget and soil-moisture response

precipitation_check.compressed_input_note: PRECTOTCORRLAND is stored independently as float32 in the compressed DA and OL files. Existing Analysis E found near-zero MODIS-only domain means but isolated monthly tile differences up to about 0.060 kg m-2. The annual tile guard detects a scientifically material forcing mismatch while retaining this known storage artifact.
precipitation_check.report: Maximum absolute annual tile difference and maximum absolute annual area-weighted domain-mean difference

storage_diagnostic.reason: The audit shows dET + dRunoff + integrated dWCHANGELAND is the near-zero model-process balance. WCHANGELAND does not include the discontinuous snow-analysis mass injection and therefore cannot equal the change in the DA-minus-OL state anomaly.
storage_diagnostic.required_check: Report both the state-proxy residual I_snow - dET - dRunoff - dStorage and the process identity dET + dRunoff + integrated dWCHANGELAND for every water year.

storage.primary_closing_term: September-to-September monthly-mean DA-minus-OL TWLAND state change
storage.state_proxy: September monthly-mean DA-minus-OL TWLAND minus prior-September monthly-mean DA-minus-OL TWLAND
storage.state_proxy_limitation: Monthly means do not provide literal October 1 and September 30 endpoint states. The same-calendar-month proxy spans 12 months at a consistent seasonal phase and is the best available independent endpoint approximation.
storage.wchangeland_role: Supporting process-tendency diagnostic only; excluded from the increment-inclusive closing storage term.

soil_water_storage.reason: The compressed monthly inputs contain SFMC and RZMC diagnostic states and total TWLAND, but no separate native prognostic soil-water storage state. RZMC and SFMC remain interpretive diagnostics and are not added to the closing budget.

snow_sublimation.reason: A latent-heat component is available, but no independently verified native snow-sublimation water-mass flux is present. EVLAND remains the established total ET term to avoid double counting.
